destinations.name: Boti Falls
destinations.description: Twin waterfalls nestled in lush forest, dropping about 30 meters into a natural pool. During rainy season, the falls form an umbrella shape. Popular swimming spot and picnic destination with scenic hiking trails.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: June to October (rainy season for full flow and umbrella effect)
destinations.entry_fee: GHS 10 for adults, GHS 5 for students
destinations.accessibility: Requires moderate hike down to falls (stairs provided)
destinations.location_details: Near Koforidua, Eastern Region. 25km from Koforidua, accessible by car.

destinations.name: Umbrella Rock
destinations.description: Unique rock formation resembling an umbrella, offering panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. Popular photography spot and natural landmark near Boti Falls.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, best views in clear weather (November-March)
destinations.location_details: Near Boti Falls, Eastern Region. Usually combined with Boti Falls visit.

destinations.name: Akosombo Dam and Lake Volta
destinations.description: Africa's largest man-made lake created by the Akosombo Dam. Impressive hydroelectric dam generating much of Ghana's electricity. Stunning lake views and boat cruise opportunities.
destinations.entry_fee: Dam viewing area free, boat cruises vary (GHS 200-500)
destinations.accessibility: Easy access, boat cruises require advance booking
destinations.location_details: Akosombo town, Eastern Region. 80km from Accra, 2-hour drive.

destinations.name: Bunso Arboretum
destinations.description: Beautiful arboretum and eco-park featuring diverse tree species, butterfly sanctuary, and nature trails. Peaceful environment for nature lovers and environmental education.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, best November-March for butterfly season
destinations.entry_fee: GHS 15 for adults, GHS 10 for students
destinations.accessibility: Easy access, suitable for all ages
destinations.location_details: Bunso, Eastern Region. 60km from Koforidua on Accra-Kumasi highway.

destinations.name: Tetteh Quarshie Cocoa Farm
destinations.description: Historic cocoa farm where Ghana's cocoa industry began. Tetteh Quarshie introduced cocoa to Ghana in 1879. Learn about cocoa farming, processing, and Ghana's cocoa heritage.

accommodations.name: Volta Hotel Akosombo
accommodations.description: Historic hotel overlooking Lake Volta with beautiful views. Comfortable accommodations with restaurant, bar, and pool. Popular stop for Lake Volta cruises.
accommodations.additional_info: Spectacular Lake Volta views. Can arrange boat cruises.

accommodations.name: Koforidua Ridge Royal Hotel
accommodations.description: Comfortable hotel in Koforidua town with good facilities. Ideal base for exploring Eastern Region attractions like Boti Falls and Umbrella Rock.
accommodations.additional_info: Central location in Koforidua, good for day trips to Eastern Region sites.

accommodations.name: Boti Falls Lodge
accommodations.description: Basic lodge near Boti Falls offering simple accommodations for nature lovers. Great for those wanting to stay close to the waterfall and explore early morning.
accommodations.additional_info: Simple accommodations for budget travelers. Very close to Boti Falls entrance.
